name: Safrimba
shortDescription: On-chain digital tontines via CosmWasm — transparent rotating savings groups.
description: Safrimba demonstrates CosmWasm usage on Safrochain: rotating savings groups with automated contribution and distribution rules. The official website highlights it in the FAQ and roadmap as a flagship product for financial inclusion. The hosted app supports Safrochain mainnet (safrimba.safrochain.com) and testnet (safrimba.test.safrochain.com).
statusNote: Live on Safrochain mainnet at safrimba.safrochain.com. Testnet at safrimba.test.safrochain.com.
